{{Top|leg}}
'''Electronic masks''' were [[Electronic translator/Legends|electronic translator]] devices worn by the [[Qieg/Legends|Qieg]]. They approximated the [[Human/Legends|Human]] voice box and reproduced the vocal ranges, allowing them to communicate with Humans as their own [[Qieg language|language]] was a series of chirps and clicks, augmented by body language.
